# Same provenance as sglang-tokenizer-metrics-per-source.txt.

# Shape this fixture exercises (ADR-014 D4): the backward-compatible path
# in observe_one_finished_request (metrics_collector.py:1688-1691), taken
# when the scheduler reports no cached_tokens_details. Every cached token
# lands under the reserved cache_source="total" and there is no per-source
# line at all.
#
# The hit-rate numerator is therefore ABSENT, not zero: excluding the
# reserved value leaves nothing to sum. A parser that read this as a zero
# numerator would report a 0.0 hit rate on a server that is in fact
# serving 2320 cached tokens out of 3400.
#
